about_the_game:
Little Retreat is your personal cozy interior design game and focus tool.

Explore unique locations like the Black Forest and more!

You can decorate, relax, and focus on your real-life tasks and with every task you finish, you will gain charmingly designed items to dress your room. With every item you unlock, your room becomes more and more your own personal space.

Create your own, individual little world

Place your items freely and create an individual, cozy environment that accompanies you while doing your real-life tasks. Place furniture, change colours and make your place come to life. Rearrange your room as often as you want and share your designs with friends.

Focus on your tasks

Decide on tasks you want to accomplish such as studying, reading or writing and set yourself a timer to work on them.

Customize your music, sound, time of day, weather, and overall mood to keep your mind clear while doing your real-life tasks.

Collect rewards

Complete your diary by collecting every item, and uncover the heartwarming stories behind them.

Make new friends

Own pets, interact with them and have them accompany you while doing your tasks. Discover secret stories and encounter friendly ghosts. 

Create the best possible home for your new friends.

Discover different rooms

Unlock different rooms with different sets of items, and discover unique locations like the Black Forest and many more. They all have different stories to uncover!
